text:
maria: heads-up - sample-app onboarding failing in python path when creating datasets. REST accepts `schema` object but python SDK seems to drop it -> 400.

jon: repro steps? which sample-app?

maria: sample-apps/onboarding/python-importer. snippet: 

```py
# python SDK v1.2.0
client.datasets.create(name='user-events', schema={'id': 'string', 'ts': 'int'})
# -> 400 Bad Request: validation_error: unknown field 'schema'
```

lee: that sounds like the client model class doesn't include schema in its to_json. Did you try inspecting outgoing request?

maria: yup I proxied traffic and payload body is `{ "name": "user-events" }` no schema key. If I call REST curl with same body including schema it works.

pat: wonder if it's a generated types/serde mismatch from the new openapi patch. Maybe `schema` was renamed to `fields` upstream and we didn't regenerate client.

jon: stacked with retries and auth nuance too: when REST returns 502 transiently, our infra retries and picks a fallback region. Python SDK has a separate retry wrapper that bails on 502 and surfaces error to app. So two issues: missing field and differing retry semantics.

maria: exact error from SDK: `redwood.errors.APIError: 400 Bad Request (validation_error): unknown field schema` stack: `File \"importer.py\", line 42, in <module> client.datasets.create(...)`

lee: can you paste the proxyed request dump?

maria: proxied dump: `POST /v1/datasets HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer ***
Content-Type: application/json

{\"name\":\"user-events\"}`

jon: ok. action plan: 1) check python client generator/input schema for dataset create model 2) add e2e parity test to CI that posts `schema` and asserts server received it 3) reconcile retry policies with infra default (we should share central retry policy).

pat: pinging eng-runtime infra folks - if python SDK retries differently we might mask region failover. Might need a compatibility layer that uses service-level retry hooks.

maria: quick workaround for the sample-app is to call REST directly using requests for dataset creation until SDK fix. I'll push a small PR to sample-app.

ci-bot: Created issue redwood/python-sdk#412: "python SDK: dataset.create omits schema field; retry behavior diverges from REST" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/issues/412 :robot_face:

lee: I'll take the SDK regen + unit tests. jon can you own parity CI test?

jon: yep, will add a small test that uses wiremock to compare SDK payload vs curl body.

maria: thanks. marking P2 for now since workaround exists but tagging for next patch release.

pat: also file note for docs: mention that until fixed, python onboarding sample uses direct REST call.

maria: ACK, will update sample-app README and link issue.

jon: any chance this affects other endpoints? maybe `ingest` or `route` libs too. I'll run a quick diff between generated models and openapi.

maria: appreciate it. will loop back once PRs land. :shipit:
